cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want you to say I saw it correctly. I'll leave the score sheet alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Sign the score as it stands, and say that ball was out.

reason: A protects the score and signing while requiring only the factual call, replacing corner-of-reality and trophy-attaching metaphors.
